name: Peremeny
source:
A story about autumn, choices, and growing up.

September. The main character transfers to a new school and tries to find his place in an unfamiliar class. This is a story about everyday life, first love, friendship, and how ordinary school days can change a life.

[From [url=https://12313132132131.itch.io/changes-in-life]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个关于秋天、抉择与成长的故事。

九月。男主角转学来到一所新学校，努力在陌生的班级里寻找属于自己的位置。这是一个讲述日常点滴、青涩初恋、真挚友情，以及平凡校园时光如何改变一个人一生的故事。

[摘自[url=https://12313132132131.itch.io/changes-in-life]itch.io[/url]]
